name: timers-keepalive-probe
description: keepalive_probe_interval (5.51; session model §9 E3, §11): how often the worker probes a silent link — SSH keepalive@openssh.com with want-reply — separate from keepalive_interval, which keeps its meaning (the missing mark and link_timeout's bound). Toward a 0.3 worker the field is on every connect and timers, in range: greater than 0 and less than a positive keepalive_interval; with keepalive_interval 0 it is ignored. The re-arm rule (session model §11): the probe is sent when now − max(last(E3), last probe) ≥ keepalive_probe_interval, so any E3 and each probe reset it and a silent link is probed once per interval, never continuously. Absent, the worker probes every keepalive_interval — v0.2's behaviour, so a set valid at v0.2.1 stays acceptable (R1) and a rolled-back v0.2 core still drives a 0.3 worker. A 0.3 worker refuses an out-of-range value with error bad_request. The core sends the field only to peers at ≥ 0.3 (D29). The default (half of keepalive_interval) is U5's config.yaml value, never a schema default (5.36). The probe cadence is graded by U3's own test (owed by the E2 worker plan); control-timers grades the field's presence, its range and its absence toward 0.2.

messages.note: toward a 0.3 worker the probe interval rides every connect: 15000, above 0 and below keepalive_interval 30000
every later timers carries it too
